Definition: from G3761 and G4218; not even at any time, i.e. never at all:--neither at any time, never, nothing at any time.
BiblicalUsage: Never is the word of absolute time. Paul says charity never fails, and Peter said to the Lord, Not so, Lord, for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe never is the word of love's endurance: charity never fails, and that is the standard I am measured by.
